"""Mirror of test_autodoc_typehints_description_no_undoc, run without pytest."""
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))

from sphinx.testing.path import path as sphinx_path  # noqa: E402
from sphinx.testing.util import SphinxTestApp  # noqa: E402

ROOTS = PROJECT / 'tests' / 'roots' / 'test-ext-autodoc'
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / 'srcdir'

shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
shutil.copytree(ROOTS, WORK)
(WORK / 'index.rst').write_text(
    '.. autofunction:: target.typehints.incr\n'
    '\n'
    '.. autofunction:: target.typehints.tuple_args\n'
    '\n'
    '   :param x: arg\n'
    '   :return: another tuple\n'
)

app = SphinxTestApp(
    'text',
    srcdir=sphinx_path(str(WORK)),
    confoverrides={'autodoc_typehints': "description",
                   'autodoc_typehints_description_target': 'documented'},
)
try:
    app.build()
    context = (app.outdir / 'index.txt').read_text()
    print('--- OUTPUT ---')
    print(context)
    print('--------------')
    print('HAS Return type:', 'Return type:' in context)
finally:
    app.cleanup()
